# spacequery

Observe-only view of one developer's machine for coding agents: agents, dirty repos, worktrees, sessions, and related occupancy. Each call builds a fresh in-memory SQLite database from providers, prints rows, and exits. It does not mutate providers.

Use it before editing, starting servers, opening PRs, or taking over old work, so the agent knows who and what already occupies the machine.

Agent skill: [skills/spacequery/SKILL.md](skills/spacequery/SKILL.md)

Installed package: `node_modules/spacequery/skills/spacequery/SKILL.md` (this file at `node_modules/spacequery/llms.txt`).

## Commands

- `spacequery <query|report>` — run a named catalog query or report
- `spacequery --sql <text>` — ad hoc SQL over the in-memory DB
- `spacequery ui` — terminal browser for tables and queries
- Common flags: `--root`, `--scope root|agents|all`, `--me`, `--json` / `--tsv`, `--trace`, `--expect-empty`, `--strict`

Named queries include `here`-style occupancy via catalog entries such as `in-dir`, `dirty`, `sessions`, `agents-with-sessions`, `worktrees` (see `--help`). Incomplete observation is explicit in the result. Prefer narrowing scope over guessing from a partial view.
